observations.finding: 20/50 pathways significant at q<0.05; strongest effects are down-regulation of HALLMARK_PANCREASE_BETA_CELLS (SMD -0.977, q=0.00025) and HALLMARK_HEME_METABOLISM (SMD -0.864, q=0.00105), with up-regulation of HALLMARK_IL6_JAK_STAT3_SIGNALING (SMD +0.684, q=0.00105), HALLMARK_ALLOGRAFT_REJECTION (SMD +0.686, q=0.00129), and HALLMARK_INFLAMMATORY_RESPONSE (SMD +0.572, q=0.00343).

2/22 genes significant at q<0.05: PBRM1 depleted in C0001 (24.6% vs 57.1%, OR 0.245, 95% CI 0.105-0.569, q=0.0224) and ATM absent in C0001 (0% vs 14.3%, OR 0.046, q=0.0404). BAP1 is enriched but not significant (18.0% vs 4.8%, OR 4.4, q=0.377).

biological_support.statistical_interpretation: C0001 shows a coherent, multi-modality molecular profile: strong RNA inflammatory/immune-activation signal with reciprocal down-regulation of metabolic pathways, significant PBRM1-depletion and ATM-absence at WXS, and concordant CNV enrichment at VHL/SETD2/PBRM1/BAP1 loci plus chr14q and CDKN2A loss. biological_support.medical_interpretation: The convergent RNA, WXS, and CNV signals support C0001 as a biologically distinguishable group with an immune/inflammatory transcriptional character and a chromatin-remodeling/CNV-altered genomic background.
